$comment: Single source of truth for tier -> model routing in omp-dev-team. The `model-routing` extension reads this file (inspect the resolved tiers and effective bands with the /routing command). Agents declare a tier in their `model:` frontmatter: small/pattern agents use the `pi/smol` role (resolved by .omp/config.yml modelRoles.smol -> a cheap CLOUD model); balanced/deep agents pin a concrete cloud model id. The small tier is a CHEAP-CLOUD high-volume tier (it replaces the expensive Sonnet/Opus calls for lexical/structural checks), not a local-GPU tier.

small.rationale: Lexical/structural pattern matching, checklist-style verification (naming, complexity, a11y, svelte, js-fp, token-efficiency, claude-setup, progress-guardian). Cheap, high-volume, parallel. Routed to whatever modelRoles.smol points at -- a cheap cloud model (default claude-haiku-4-5; with the copilot-preset plugin, e.g. github-copilot/gpt-5-mini).

balanced.rationale: Semantic analysis with balanced cost/quality (most team agents + most review agents + orchestrator).

deep.rationale: Cross-file reasoning, high-stakes design synthesis, threat modeling, broad reconnaissance (security-review, domain-review, arch-review, architect, security-engineer, codebase-recon).

effortBand.$comment: Effort-band routing (phase-aware bump-from-floor): the model is derived from the TASK SIZE (task-size-classifier, recorded by /scope in plan-gate state) and the PIPELINE STAGE, floored by the agent's declared tier. Put the effort into spec/plan: the size raises the band ONLY while planning (stage in bumpStages, default needs-plan); once the plan is approved, build/review run at the floor (a solid plan makes the build routine). effective = (stage in bumpStages) ? max(floor, sizeBand[size]) : floor. The agent tier is a FLOOR — never routed below it (high-stakes deep agents hold). No signal -> floor (static, retro-compatible). copilot-preset is unaffected — the band picks a tier, then modelRoles resolves the model.
effortBand.$downshiftNote: Off by default. Set trivialDownshift:true to route agents ONE band below their floor on the fast path (downshiftStages, default trivial) for extra token saving — except a floor in protectDownshift (deep), which holds. This is the only case an agent goes below its declared tier; leave it off to keep the never-below-floor guarantee.
effortBand.$enforcementNote: advisory: the extension logs + warns on a dispatch whose tier != the effort-band tier (the orchestrator applies the rule). Set env DEV_TEAM_EFFORT_ROUTING=enforce to upgrade the warning to a block, or =off to disable the band entirely (pure static tiers, agent tier only).

notes: Keep the high-volume `small` tier on the cheapest capable model to limit token spend; reserve balanced/deep for work that needs them. Pair with the copilot-preset and token-diet plugins for further cost control.
